name: Hammock Beach Golf Resort & Spa
positioning: Oceanfront golf and beach resort on Florida's Atlantic Coast in Palm Coast, with condominium suites, golf-view villas and The Lodge, a boutique hotel on the grounds
best_for: Golfers who want a Jack Nicklaus course with oceanfront holes and a second course by Tom Watson
Families and groups who want multi-bedroom condominiums or villas with full kitchens
Guests traveling with a pet, who can stay at The Lodge

facts.text: The resort sits on a stretch of unspoiled beach along Florida's Atlantic Coast in Palm Coast.
The Ocean Course is the home of Constellation Furyk & Friends presented by Circle K, a PGA TOUR Champions event.
The Tom Watson-designed Conservatory Course has rolling fairways, waterfalls and distinctive stonework.
The condominiums have a master bedroom with a private bathroom, dual vanities, a walk-in shower, a large garden tub and a covered open-air balcony with ocean or golf course views.
The Lodge's Ocean Front King rooms are closest to the shoreline, with direct Atlantic views from a private balcony.
The Lodge's Ocean View Suite has a king bedroom, a separate sitting area and two private balconies overlooking the ocean, pool and golf course.
The two- and three-bedroom villas have golf and marsh views and are a short stroll from the main resort.
The villas have full kitchens, private balconies and in-room laundry.
The resort has a Water Park and a spa close to the Main Tower condominiums.
Atlantic Grille serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with ocean views and shore-to-table seafood.
Hammock House is a casual clubhouse restaurant with a wide veranda and ocean views over the 9th green.

highlights.text: The Jack Nicklaus-designed Ocean Course has six oceanfront holes.
Resort amenities include a multi-level pool complex.
The full-service on-site spa offers signature treatments using thalassotherapy products rich in minerals from the sea.
The Lodge at Hammock Beach is an oceanfront boutique hotel on the resort grounds.
The Ocean Tower ocean view three-bedroom condominiums have an open-concept layout with a gourmet kitchen and a living space with a fireplace.

considerations.text: The vacation rental condos are in Cinnamon Beach and Yacht Harbor Village, a short drive from the heart of the resort.
WhataHotel notes resort fees and additional charges for amenities.
